implementation.procedure: Check public profile resolver and actual thread/start configuration.
implementation.acceptance: Only complete explicit empty external requirements narrow apps/node; unknown/required keeps defaults. No config file, permission or instruction changes.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check malformed/duplicate/incomplete contracts and unexpected external server tools before dispatch.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Ambiguous requirements never narrow; unknown tools/errors/pagination block no-external profile.

data_integrity.procedure: Read raw fresh-thread JSONL and bound fixture/config/source hashes; inspect actual outcome types.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly one completed turn per invocation, no tools/subagents or failures, no missing or duplicate usage; independent checker recomputes actual totals.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Total each terminal input+output; cached input is a subset; compare A/B and fixed output oracle.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both outputs satisfy all short fixture constraints, combined total<=50000 and candidate total strictly lower; no estimates counted.

measurement_validity.procedure: Same server, identical prompt/schema/model/high effort/project roots and original host policies; only declared external capability exposure differs. Inspect actual rollout text and raw tool catalogs.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Base/project/permission text unchanged; allow only exact declared tool availability and unused external capability catalog differences; core role rules remain. Two fresh no-tool turns, quota before each, max two calls zero retries, 90s per call, first<=25000/combined<=50000.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent host replays public CLI resolver/fixtures/actual accounting and targeted checks without model calls.
reproducibility.acceptance: Source/input/config usage bindings match, identical three-blocker oracle, separate verification owner; no long-document or cash saving claim.

scope: same native app-server, identical supplied short reading task; only explicit external tool exposure changes
success_requires: exact base/project/permission text matches; only declared capability catalog differences allowed
source/input/config bindings and independent verification pass
